description: This script is a test suite for Git operations related to checking out branches, particularly focusing on behaviors involving unborn branches, untracked files, index contents, and orphan branches. It uses a testing framework with functions like test_expect_success and test_done, and performs various Git commands to validate repository states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, runs the given commands, and records the result.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail; the test passes if the command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
